shared_elements: standing figure in profile with bent/raised arm
bearded head with curled hair rendered in rows of tight curls
elaborately patterned long garment with fringes/rows of texture
hand grasping a small handled object
wing rendered as overlapping rows of long feathers
stylised floral/rosette motifs filling the field
horizontal register band of repeated rosettes or discs
justification: Both show low-relief profile figures with tightly curled beards and hair, densely patterned fringed robes, an arm raised holding a small handled object, wings built from stacked rows of long feathers, and a horizontal band of repeated rosettes with stylised floral filler — a very specific and shared set of conventions. The chief difference in content is that A shows a single hybrid bird-headed winged figure occupying the whole field amid a dense floral thicket, while B shows a repeated file of human-headed figures in tall headdresses stacked in registers.
